text:
alex: Heads up: regen diff in JS SDK broke the RC pipeline. sample-app onboarding CI shows type-hash mismatch.
jamie: Can you paste the diff?
alex: ```
- export interface WidgetConfig { id: string; createdAt?: string; tags?: string[] }
+ export interface WidgetConfig { createdAt?: string; id: string; tags?: string[] }
```
jamie: Property order shuffled by OpenAPI generator update. Two fixes: enable deterministic property sort in codegen or pin generator version.
alex: I prefer not to touch upstream spec. Let's configure generator: stablePropertySort=true in tools/typegen/config.yml and regen.
ci-bot: publish-gate: blocked - typehash mismatch reported.
jamie: Also semver guard flagged changelog says "minor" but this is internal parity fix. We need to update changelog entry to "patch: SDK regen parity fix" to pass semver gating.
alex: I'll open PR with stable sort config, regenerated types, updated type-hash, and changelog edit. Will run sample-app tests locally before push.
release-ops-bot: Noted; if CI still fails after PR, request release exception with justification: "regen parity, non-user-facing".
